item.title: Elations Software subscription and support
item.description:
Housing Preservation and Development | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-09-25 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Housing Preservation and Development intends to award a $300,000 negotiated contract to Elation Systems Inc. of Portsmouth, New Hampshire, for software subscription and user support from Jan. 1, 2026, through Dec. 31, 2027, with one renewal of up to two years.

Pursuant to Section 3-04(b)(2)(i)(C),(D) and (ii) of the Procurement Policy Board Rules, the Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) intends to enter into a Negotiated Acquisition contract with Elation Systems Inc., located at 104 Congress Street, Suite 304 Portsmouth, New Hampshire 03801. This contract is for the provision of Core Product Subscription Service and ongoing user support, live phone support during standard business hours, with the ability to schedule a support appointment and callback. The contract term is 01/1/2026 - 12/31/2027 with one renewal for up to two (2) years. The ePIN for this award is 80626N0004 and the proposed budget is $300,000.  

THIS NOTICE IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. Vendors can express interest in responding to a future procurement to provide these services by sending such request via email to channang@hpd.nyc.gov.

item.title: City Housing Assistance Program (CHAP)
item.description:
Housing Preservation and Development | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-09-10 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Housing Preservation and Development intends to award Nan McKay and Associates Inc. a negotiated contract to run a new City Housing Assistance Program voucher program for rental assistance, with responses due Sept. 10, 2026.

The Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) seeks services for a new rental assistance voucher program as required by the Stipulation of Settlement between Vincent, et al. v. Adams, The Council of the City of New York v. Mayor Eric Adams and Preconsidered Int. No. 966, which amended Title 26 of the NYC Administrative Code to add a new Chapter 39 from Nan McKay and Associates Inc. (NMA) through a negotiated acquisition, pursuant to Sections 3 04(b)(2)(i)(A) and 3-04(b)(2)(i)(D) of the NYC Procurement Policy Board Rules. Legislation, codified in the NYC Administrative Code Title 26, added a new Chapter 39 which requires the establishment of a New York City Housing Assistance Program (CityHAP) to be operated by HPD. The new program will serve income-eligible populations that also meet the following criteria: tenants in rent-stabilized housing facing eviction proceedings, households in non-DSS shelters such as runaway and homeless youth, and households in DSS shelter whose income exceeds 200% of the federal poverty level or who cannot meet the work requirements of CityFHEPS. item.title: IT SR. DEVELOPER TENANT ACCOUNTING SYSTEM MAINTENANCE FY27
item.description:
Housing Preservation and Development | Procurement | Award | $65K | Vendor: Cyber Sphere LLC In plain English (machine-written): The city's Department of Housing Preservation and Development awarded Cyber Sphere LLC a $64,800 contract, without competitive bidding, to maintain the Tenant Accounting System that tracks rent, tenant records and billing for city-owned housing.

The Tenant Accounting System, hereafter TAS, houses a repository of tenant accounts pertaining to individuals occupying city owned and managed properties. This requires TAS to furnish rent roll management functions, maintaining property and tenant records, billing and receivable streams and reporting streams for Housing Preservation and Development Property Management Office.
